sys_script.description: Thin adapter: when submission_line.underwriter is set for the FIRST time (was empty), delegate to UWTriggerReasonResolver (loa, isFirstEver) + LOAEvaluationVersionService to create the next loa_evaluation header. submission_line.underwriter is the canonical "underwriter assigned to this submission line" field (indexed for that purpose) - NOT x_gegis_ins_policy_case_task.assigned_to, which is a generic task-assignment field reused across HITL/referral/extraction task categories.
sys_script.name: LOA trigger on first underwriter assignment
